hero.name: Shengxing Station building
hero.silhouette: Small Japanese-era cream timber-clapboard station house with a grey corrugated metal gable roof beside railway tracks

crop: The station house, platform and track with the old-street slope behind. Not the tunnels or the bridge ruins.
orientation: Rail corridor runs roughly north-northwest to south-southeast, with old-street buildings east of the tracks and wooded slopes west (satellite).
lockedGeometry: single disused track along the platform
lockedIdentity: grey corrugated metal gable roof on cream wooden clapboard walls, confirmed by photos and cultural heritage record
station name board without readable text
